title: Meghalaya
subtitle: A 6-Day Journey Through Living Bridges, Clouds & Rivers
overview: A 6-day loop through Meghalaya covering Shillong's viewpoints, the waterfalls and caves of Sohra (Cherrapunji), the living root bridges of Nongriat and Mawlynnong, and the crystal-clear Umngot River at Dawki.

notes.label: Best time to visit
notes.text: September to February for clear skies; June to August for fuller waterfalls.

notes.label: Good to know
notes.text: Carry cash — many local ticket counters do not accept UPI or cards.

activities.name: Shillong Peak
activities.note: Best panoramic view of the city; photo ID required
